report_text: Patient admitted to ICU with septic shock requiring ventilator support and vasopressors.
Complex case with multiple comorbidities; surgery planned for unstable angina; poorly controlled diabetes.
Uncomplicated urinary tract infection, responding to oral antibiotics, no ICU care.
Recurrent hospitalizations with worsening heart failure symptoms and renal impairment.
Moderate asthma exacerbation controlled with inhaled bronchodilators and steroids; no ICU admission.
